quote: The customer may request an audit of Globex's security controls on 30 days' written notice, not more than twice per calendar year.
policy_quote: We must retain the right to audit vendor's controls on at least 30 days' notice. Violation: no audit clause, or audit clause requiring more than 90 days' notice.
reason: Audit notice is 30 days, which meets the requirement and is not above the 90-day violation threshold.
